1.text: {name} watches the scenery outside the window as the shuttle ambles along the road towards {possessive} new home for the next two years.
Trees bleed into pristine white buildings and clear blue skies– it’s a nice day out.

1.speaker: Shuttle Conductor
1.text: Stopping soon at Astraea University. Next stop, Astraea University.

1.speaker: {name}
1.text: Crap. That’s my stop. I didn’t realize it’d be such a short trip.

1.speaker: {name}
1.text: Everything here is so sparkly– it’s hard to believe that this university is hundreds of years old when some of the buildings look brand new. It’s almost … unsettling.

1.speaker: {name}
1.text: I was here last week to talk to auntie … but .. I don’t really recognize anything. Maybe it’s just too new to me.

1.speaker: {name}
1.text: After everything, after... Mom. I need this.

1.speaker: Shuttle Conductor
1.text: Now arriving at Astraea University. Arriving, Astraea University.

1.speaker: {name}
1.text: Oops. That’s me. Hopefully Jay won’t be hard to find. He said he’d meet me at the shuttle stop, but there’re more than a few people here … maybe he’ll find me before I find him?

1.speaker: {name}
1.text: He said green sweater and blue jeans … ah, that might be him over there?

2.text: {name} steps off the bus into the sunlight. The shuttle terminal is moderately populated, with people hopping off other shuttles or waiting for others.
As {subject} walks towards who {subject} thinks might be Jay, an attractive white-haired student about {object} age bumps roughly into {object}.

2.speaker: {name}
2.text: Ouch– hey! Sorry, I didn’t mean to bump into y–

2.speaker: Unknown
2.text: Tch. Hey. Your eyes for decoration? Watch yourself.
